name: Personyze
description:
Describe the campaign you want and Personyze builds it — a welcome offer for first-time visitors, a recommendation row on the cart page, an A/B test on your pricing headline, or a homepage rewritten for enterprise buyers.

Claude can read your account and act on it: check what's live, look at how campaigns are performing, inspect audiences and goals, then create a new campaign draft with real targeting rules and content styled from your own site. Everything lands in staging, so nothing reaches a visitor until you publish it.

Beyond building, the server covers the day-to-day: traffic and visitor analytics, per-product recommendation stats, audience membership, goals and conversion tracking, A/B traffic splits, scheduled reports, site audit and tracking-status checks, and a searchable documentation lookup.

Works alongside the Personyze panel and the WordPress plugin — the same account, the same campaigns, whichever way you reach them.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Personyze to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Personyze to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://personyze.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Personyze MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Personyze lists 23 MCP tools, including add_audience_member, create_audience, create_campaign_draft, create_placeholder, delete_audience, get_action_content, get_campaign_performance, get_campaign_targeting, get_product_stats, get_traffic_analytics, get_visitors, and list_actions.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Personyze?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Personyze in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Personyze requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Personyze is developed by Personyze. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
